memories.author: A
memories.title: self-care friday mornings
memories.text: This coffee shop fueled my creativity and reminded me who I was during tough times.

memories.author: A
memories.title: sunny reflection
memories.text: Sun bathing here during the healing process of a difficult breakup was pivotal to my process of moving on. This was one way I explored time outdoors as my favorite form of self-care.

memories.author: A
memories.title: marching band memories
memories.text: As a member of the marching band, UW football games are a significant piece of my college experience. This stadium has begun to feel like home. I'm not ready to leave it all behind.

memories.author: A
memories.title: first college class
memories.text: My first ever college class was in this building. I remember the day as super rainy, and I wasn't used to climbing up hills yet. I was covered in rain by the time I got there, and the professor showed up late.

memories.author: A
memories.title: a lunch break cry
memories.text: I sat under this tree and cried for a while one sunny spring day. A squirrel came and cheered me up.

memories.author: A
memories.title: picnic with the gals
memories.text: I've had many a picnic at gas works during the spring with the girlies. Looking out at the Seattle skyline past the water reminds me why I moved here.

memories.author: A
memories.title: kayak date
memories.text: I had one of my favorite dates here. My partner took my through the lily pads in a kayak and showed me a place that was special to him. We sat and talked for ever on the water.

memories.author: A
memories.title: long hours in the basement
memories.text: My office is in the basement of this building and I've spent way too many hours working down there loosing track of time.

memories.author: A
memories.title: community
memories.text: The people I've lived with in this house have been some of the strongest community I've ever experienced.

memories.author: A
memories.title: god bless trader joes
memories.text: oh how I love trader joe's. their frozen food and unique desserts have carried me through college. also the go-to spot for picnic treats.

memories.author: A
memories.title: hinge date
memories.text: During my single era I went on a hinge date with a guy here who was apparently a dj. I never saw him again...

memories.author: A
memories.title: dorm blues
memories.text: maple hall was my dorm freshman year. all of my friends lived on north campus and I felt pretty lonely here.

memories.author: A
memories.title: illegal parking
memories.text: I've never paid to park in this lot. I've come the believe that the traffic cop just passes my car intentionally.

memories.text: accepted my offer here with a prickly pear margarita

memories.author: C

memories.text: worked as a research assistant in ece for almost 3 years!

memories.author: C
memories.title: "girlhouse"
memories.text: though i never lived here, this house feels like home. so much happened here, good and bad, that defined my college experience

memories.author: C
memories.title: the worst day of college
memories.text: left a terrible meeting here and immediately got terrible news. wouldn't wish that day on anyone,

memories.author: C
memories.title: seattle feels like home
memories.text: i hate seattle weather 99% of the time, but the first true sunny day of spring at the cut with friends is one of the most blissful experiences in the world.

memories.author: C
memories.title: walking study
memories.text: did a sociology study where i had to walk around union bay with no phone, no earbuds, etc, for 6 weeks in a row. found it incredibly healing.

memories.author: C
memories.title: meeting my best friend / roommate
memories.text: before freshman year even started, this was our first time meeting in person. she greeted me with a hug.

memories.author: C
memories.title: crying on a frat lawn
memories.text: sobbed on the phone with an ex during a frat party. not my proudest moment,  passersby were very concerned.

memories.author: C
memories.title: naptime
memories.text: took a nap after a difficult exam on this bench in the springtime. may have looked crazy but i don't regret it.
